description:
The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme was launched on 1st September 2021. 

This initiative was introduced by the Chief Minister of Delhi, Arvind Kejriwal. 

The primary objective of the programme is to provide young individuals with an opportunity to gain practical experience in governance. 

The scheme aims to engage students and recent graduates in the functioning of the Delhi government. 

It is designed to enhance their understanding of public administration and policy-making processes. 

The programme targets youth aged between 18 and 30 years. 

Eligible candidates must be residents of Delhi. 

They should have completed at least one year of their undergraduate degree or be pursuing a postgraduate degree. 

The programme is open to students from all educational backgrounds. 

Interns will receive a monthly stipend of ₹10,000. 

The total duration of the internship is six months. 

Interns will work closely with various departments of the Delhi government. 

They will be involved in projects that align with the government's vision for a developed Delhi. 

The programme aims to provide hands-on experience in areas such as policy research, data analysis, and project implementation. 

Interns will also have the opportunity to attend workshops and seminars. 

These sessions will be conducted by experts in various fields. 

The application process for the Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must apply online through the official website of the Delhi government. 

The application form requires basic personal information and educational qualifications. 

Candidates must submit a statement of purpose explaining their interest in the internship. 

The deadline for applications is typically set a month before the internship starts. 

Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. 

The selection process is competitive and aims to identify the most suitable candidates. 

Once selected, interns will receive an official appointment letter. 

They will be required to submit documents such as identity proof and educational certificates. 

Interns will be expected to maintain a professional demeanor throughout the programme. 

They will be evaluated based on their performance and contributions. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is implemented by the Delhi Government's Department of Training and Technical Education. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the internship process and ensuring its smooth operation. 

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official Delhi government website. 

The programme is part of a broader initiative to empower youth in Delhi. 

It aligns with the Delhi government's commitment to fostering a skilled workforce. 

The government aims to provide practical exposure to students to prepare them for future employment. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme also emphasizes the importance of civic engagement. 

Interns will be encouraged to participate in community service activities. 

This aspect of the programme aims to instill a sense of responsibility towards society. 

The government has set a target to enroll at least 1,000 interns annually. 

This target reflects the government's commitment to youth empowerment. 

The programme also aims to build a bridge between academic knowledge and practical application. 

Interns will have the chance to network with professionals in the field of governance. 

They will gain insights into the functioning of the Delhi government. 

The programme is expected to enhance the employability of participants. 

By providing real-world experience, the internship aims to equip interns with valuable skills. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a significant step towards involving youth in governance. 

It seeks to create a pool of informed and engaged citizens. 

The initiative is part of a larger vision for a developed Delhi. 

The government is committed to transparency and accountability in its operations. 

Interns will be encouraged to provide feedback on their experiences. 

This feedback will be used to improve the programme in subsequent years. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a unique opportunity for young people. 

It allows them to contribute to the development of their city. 

The programme is expected to foster a sense of ownership among the youth. 

By participating, interns can influence policy decisions that affect their lives. 

The government aims to create a culture of active participation in governance. 

This initiative reflects the Delhi government's focus on inclusive growth. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a model for similar initiatives across India. 

It highlights the importance of engaging youth in the democratic process. 

The programme is expected to have a lasting impact on the participants and the community. 

The government is optimistic about the outcomes of this initiative. 

It believes that empowering youth will lead to a more vibrant and responsive governance system. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a step towards building a better future for Delhi. 

It aims to harness the potential of young minds for the development of the city. 

The programme is a testament to the Delhi government's commitment to youth empowerment. 

It is an opportunity for young individuals to make a difference in their community. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is an initiative that stands out for its focus on practical experience. 

It is designed to prepare the next generation of leaders in governance. 

The programme is expected to evolve based on the needs of the participants and the community. 

The Delhi government is committed to ensuring the success of this initiative. 

It aims to create a sustainable model for youth engagement in governance. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a forward-thinking initiative. 

It reflects the changing dynamics of youth involvement in public affairs. 

The government is hopeful that this programme will inspire similar efforts nationwide. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a significant contribution to the welfare of Delhi's youth. 

It is an opportunity for young people to learn and grow in a supportive environment. 

The programme is a vital part of the Delhi government's strategy for youth development. 

It aims to create informed citizens who are actively engaged in their communities. 

The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a promising initiative for the future of Delhi.
